infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NigChat uses the camera to scan the pairing code shown on nigchat.com, and to take photos to send.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: NigChat needs access to your photos so you can share them in chats.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NigChat uses the microphone for voice notes and calls.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: NigChat matches your contacts so you can find people you already know. Numbers are hashed before they leave your device.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: NigChat uses Face ID to unlock locked chats.

plugins.cameraPermission: NigChat uses the camera to scan the pairing code shown on the web app.

plugins.faceIDPermission: NigChat uses Face ID to unlock the app and locked chats on this device.

plugins.photosPermission: NigChat needs access to your photos so you can set a profile picture and share images in chats.
